+## 🔎 Scope and recovery checkpoint — 2026-11-21
+
+Agent judgment, before implementation: retain effort **M** for the complete outcome.
+Existing receipt indexing, bounded maintenance, transactional accounting and
+immutable paired exports supply the necessary architecture. Adapt the recovered
+implementation to main's supervisor writer and landed feedback contract; do not
+replay old dependencies, backlog counters or completion claims. Verification
+includes the actual application timer, storage/export integration, changed UI
+states and selected browser/native-platform owners. No scope is deferred.
+
+Base: `9072a66a719cbf9bc8d4d4e814562950165026dc` (includes SPN-106).
+Recovered implementation: `09093eb64c08cd262acc8390c64581a7f82c5fc2`;

+The historical [local logs](evidence/SPN-110-local.json) and
+[paired-export rows](evidence/SPN-110-paired-export.json) remain unchanged.
+In particular, the old application-timer memory abort and old focused/native
+passes do not establish current acceptance. Original PR: #247.
+
+## ⏳ Receipt policy and bounded upkeep
+
+Accepted agent implementation choice, 2026-11-21, preserving the owner's
+seven-day maximum target: deployment can select 1–7 whole days, default seven;
+invalid configuration fails startup. Use the existing one-minute health timer
+and maintenance gate. Scan at most 1,024 candidates plus one lookahead using
+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.
+A process-local `(received_at, rowid)` cursor advances only on successful work;
+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.
+
+Delete only observations strictly older than the trusted receipt cutoff, and
+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.
+Keep physical/write-reserve limits and retryable failure; no index allocation,
+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.
+Maximum age is a target during healthy maintenance, not a completeness guarantee
+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.
+
+Operator gains bounded upkeep and content-free failure status. Owner and
+Collaborator retain deliberate reports and idempotent receipts while minimizing
+operational data. Link guests gain no diagnostic authority. All personas retain
+unchanged workspace history, trash, backups, recovery journal and access rules.
+
+## 🧪 Current test plan and evidence
+
+- Store/configuration/capacity suites own controlled cutoff equality, forged
+  client timestamps, queued observations, bounded feedback traversal, restart,
+  clock changes, failed deletion rollback, exact accounting and continued ingest.
+  Reuse isolated databases and close/remove them in fixture cleanup.
+- The existing feedback suite owns real paired-file byte/membership stability,
+  durable feedback/flags/retry acknowledgments, missing-context disclosure and
+  explicit truncate invalidation. Replace pre-expiry simulation with real expiry;
+  retain main's adapter/privacy checks and real exporter.
+- `server/app.test.ts` owns startup/minute/close timer wiring and failure/retry
+  health status with controlled intervals and real SQLite/API observations.
+- Existing diagnostics Playwright journeys own real browser authorization,
+  download/clear interactions and light/dark/390px captures. Production component
+  stories cover loss counts and failed maintenance. Independent visual approval
+  is required, **agent review only**. Selected native CI remains required.
+- Existing CI source/shared dependency routing selects diagnostics, maintenance,
+  health, browser and diagnostics-library owners. No new suite or workflow.
+  Verify selection and fail-closed selected-worker controls. Every local workload
+  uses pinned Node 26.13.0, shared serial lock and pressure/2 GiB watchdog.
+
+Current results will be recorded here and in the final PR; no historical result
+is carried forward as a pass.
+
+### 🛠️ Recovery and first-failure dispositions
+
+The first focused run found duplicated maintenance imports from the three-way
+recovery; removing the duplicates allowed the suite to execute. Existing
+maintenance-store assertions then detected a missing receipt timestamp on the
+newer internal maintenance append path; capture it there as well as normal
+backend/frontend ingestion. The supervisor test exposed the registry rejecting
+the new `expired` loss dimension: accept bounded optional expiry counts for
+archived-row compatibility, keep fixed fields, and test invalid/extra dimensions.
+The supervisor now reads the same validated deployment policy. These are repaired
+integration defects, not waived failures.
+
+The first full typecheck found the fixture helper inferred UUID-template text
+instead of the receipt's string ID; explicitly type its ID parameter. The next
+full typecheck was pressure-aborted (peak 1,767,392 KiB); lower Go memory settings
+allowed the full check to pass (14,069 ms, peak 1,868,016 KiB), without changing
+the 2 GiB/normal-pressure guard. The actual application timer passed, and the
+full 23-case application suite then passed with emitter failure/success assertions.
+Both independent reviewers later identified a possible arbitrary-UUID row choice
+in that fixture. It now waits for/selects a specific runtime observation and
+orders emitted attempts by rowid. They also requested reuse of `seedCopies` and
+removal of an unrelated historical documentation rewrap; both are repaired.
+
+Two full local Storybook builds were pressure-aborted (14,918 ms/1,637,744 KiB
+and 10,603 ms/1,661,600 KiB). A focused temporary configuration imports the real
+main/preview and selects only ServerHealth/AdminDiagnostics stories. Its first
+command used an obsolete CLI path and failed before building; the corrected
+installed binary completed in 4,398 ms/888,256 KiB. This is affected-component
+acceptance, not a claim that a full local catalogue built. Hosted Storybook owns
+the broader selected checks. Temporary config and test processes are task-owned.
+
+### ✅ Local acceptance and review repairs
+
+Production sources are committed at `664e84a44b1f5ca223aa71ea11cc633eb030d7fb`;
+timer-test determinism/shared fixtures at `58cbb3e327f81c0767dce0d3bf017ab76308a039`.
+Independent reviewer A ran **119/119 tests in 11 files** (8,144 ms,
+1,166,416 KiB peak); reviewer B ran **174/174 in 19 files**, including all
+23 application tests (11,648 ms, 1,075,904 KiB). Both are first-attempt passes
+on `58cbb3e3`, without skips, retries or guard changes. Reviewer A's visual
+inspection found the failure story inherited an impossible success-after-failure
+timestamp. `0bc71b97bef16d54b56b2a1ce8d3edcb206f76f6` repairs that fixture;
+all five affected theme/viewport states were recaptured and passed (3,652 ms,
+583,088 KiB), then independently approved, **agent review only**.
+
+The actual production diagnostics browser journey passed on `664e84a4`:
+**1/1 first attempt**, 11,874 ms, 1,881,424 KiB peak. Its light/dark/390px
+application captures and representative production-component failure/nonzero-count
+captures are [retained with exact source/hash/caption metadata](../review-assets/spn-110/README.md).
+The unchanged component sources make the application images applicable to the
+repaired test/story commits. Full lint passed (19,361 ms,703,056 KiB); all
+**27 routing/selection/fail-closed controls** passed (2,574 ms,423,296 KiB)
+on `0bc71b97`. They preserve selected missing/failed-worker rejection and all
+seven static gates. Final full repository typecheck on `0bc71b97` also passed (14,896 ms,
+1,802,048 KiB peak). No dependency, routing, budget or workflow was relaxed.
+
+[Current logs, exact commands, test names and measured resource results](evidence/SPN-110-current.json)
+retain first failures alongside their successful repair runs. Guard measurements
+are combined local process-tree RSS, not deployment-memory benchmarks. Final
+exact-head grades, hosted run/plan/check identities, native browser evidence and
+merge/cleanup identities belong in PR #247's final description. They remain
+required; local results and historical archives cannot replace them.

+

+invalid configuration fails startup. Use the existing one-minute health timer
+and maintenance gate. Scan at most 1,024 candidates plus one lookahead using
+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.
+A process-local `(received_at, rowid)` cursor advances only on successful work;
+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.

+

+only the existing receipt index. Retained feedback counts against that budget.

+completed sweeps, restart and truncate reset it. Backward-clock arrivals are
+revisited on the next sweep, not silently skipped by a durable watermark.

+subtract their exact bytes in the same transaction. Enqueue captures receipt
+time; delayed flush cannot renew lifetime. Invalid clocks fail without deletion.

+forced vacuum or scheduler is required before an already-full store can recover.
+Expiry never changes the explicit truncate generation or prepared export files.

+or a claim about old exports/backups. Counters describe only this process.
